segments.source: This version of the text assumes you’re using Lean 4 (specifically {versionString}[]).
See the [Quickstart section](https://lean-lang.org/documentation/setup/) of the Lean documentation to install Lean.
segments.translation: Lean을 설치하려면 Lean 문서의 [빠른 시작 섹션](https://lean-lang.org/documentation/setup/)을 참고하십시오.

segments.source: The first version of this book was written for Lean 2, and the Lean 3 version is available [here](https://leanprover.github.io/theorem_proving_in_lean/).
segments.translation: 이 책의 첫 번째 판은 Lean 2를 기준으로 작성되었으며, Lean 3 판은 [여기](https://leanprover.github.io/theorem_proving_in_lean/)에서 볼 수 있습니다.
